newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end mixed, Argentaria storms higher.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end mixed, Argentaria storms higher.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed mixed on Wednesday after a session of consolidation prompted by recent towering gains, traders said.
Spanish bank Argentaria delivered a sparkling performance, rising 380 pesetas to 7,120, after announcing plans to cut staff and reduce costs.

The general index slipped 0.09 points, 0.02 percent, to 524.12, while the Ibex-35 of leading shares fell 0.58 points, 0.01 percent, to 6,042.57. Turnover was more subdued than previous sessions with almost 83 billion pesetas traded.

"The stock market is continuing to consolidate, but there isn't much selling and even if there were a bigger correction we'd see the bull trend resume because no-one wants to stay out of the bourse," one trader said.
Among other individual stocks, Telefonica rose 30 pesetas to 3,845 with 2.9 million shares changing hands. Repsol slipped 60 pesetas to 6,040.

"The most logical thing would be for the consolidation to continue for some days but the absence of alternative investments and the good news about the economy mean funds will naturally flow into stocks," one dealer said.
